svg.title: PARMAR mobile experience reference collection
svg.desc: Ten mobile screen design references for existing PARMAR features. The canonical VOKKI portrait is used from the approved project asset. The original PARMAR knot-and-wordmark crops come directly from Logo.jpg.
svg.text: A responsive companion for thoughtful, human-governed AI
Reference layouts use real PARMAR destinations only. Canonical VOKKI portrait restored from the original project asset.
